'''Bat rays''' are an aquatic [[vermin]] that can be found year-round in [[biome|temperate]] and [[biome|tropical]] [[ocean|oceans]], and are a ready source of [[food]] when [[fish cleaning|cleaned]] at a [[fishery]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] bat rays for their ''shape''.
